recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it completes the remaining source-level example correction without changing broader search modifier semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-20001 was a Published FHIR-core search change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that text-search examples use uppercase AND and listing examples for _text and name:text.
initial_application: The explicit Apply FHIR-20001 commit e1834a99c8 corrected the _text example in source/search.html from lowercase and to uppercase AND. Later/current search-page source still had the string :text example as Composition?section:text=(bone OR liver) and metastases.
additional_context: FHIR-17461 and its linked Zulip thread confirm :text is an intentional string modifier distinct from the _text search parameter, so FHIR-20001 should not be interpreted as removing :text. FHIR-32673 later added :text-advanced for token/reference searches while preserving string :text advanced-search semantics, making the current Composition :text example the relevant successor surface.
reconciliation: Changed the GET and POST Composition?section:text example in source/search.html to use uppercase AND, matching the accepted FHIR-20001 operator style and the already-correct _text example.
source_changes: source/search.html: changed the Composition?section:text GET and POST examples from lowercase "and" to uppercase "AND".

related_jiras.note: Confirmed that :text remains an intentional modifier distinct from _text.
Later split token/reference advanced text search into :text-advanced while preserving string :text semantics.
